text: On 2026-11-26 the wind fleet generated a mean of 13181 MW, ranging from a minimum of 10833 MW to a maximum of 17399 MW. Compared with the previous seven‑day average of 8950 MW, wind output was 47.3% higher. System demand averaged 36007 MW and peaked at 43873 MW, 7.0% above the prior week’s mean of 33651 MW. The average price was £221.6/MWh, with a low of £137.3/MWh and a high of £297.2/MWh, representing a 17.5% increase on the week‑ago average of £188.6/MWh. Day‑ahead wind forecasts had a mean absolute error of 1682 MW versus a baseline error of 1546 MW, while demand forecasts posted an MAE of 1106 MW against a baseline of 1888 MW and a MAPE of 3.18%. Data‑quality checks covered 29 series, with 25 passing, 2 warnings and 2 failures. Issues flagged were wind_onshore: FAIL, wind_offshore: FAIL, price_apx: WARN and price_n2ex: WARN.
